summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K) on September 30, 2026, furnishing a news release announcing its participation in Renmark Financial Communications' Virtual Non-Deal Roadshow on October 7, 2026 at 10:00 AM EST. CEO Frederick Bell and CIO David Baker will present the investor update and host a live Q&A. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine investor-relations notice, not a special situation.
